sentences.text: ORAL ORDER 1.

By way of the present application under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, the applicant - accused has prayed for anticipatory bail in connection with the FIR being C. R.
No.11210008230874 of 2023 registered with Sarthana Police Station, Kamrej- Surat City for the offences punishable under Sections 409, 420, 120 (B) and 34 of the Indian Penal Code.

sentences.text: 2. Learned advocate for the applicant submits that the nature of allegations are such for which custodial interrogation at this stage is not necessary.
He further submits that the applicant will keep himself available during the course of investigation, trial also and will not flee from justice.

sentences.text: Learned advocate for the applicant on instructions states that the applicant is ready and willing to abide by all the conditions including imposition of conditions with regard to NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/11133/2023 ORDER DATED: 19/08/2023 undefined powers of Investigating Agency to file an application before the competent Court for his remand.
He further submit that upon filing of such application by the Investigating Agency, the right of applicant accused to oppose such application on merits may be kept open.
Learned advocate, therefore, submitted that considering the above facts, the applicant may be granted anticipatory bail.
4. Learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing on behalf of the respondent - State has opposed grant of anticipatory bail looking to the nature and gravity of the offence.

5. Having heard the learned advocates for the parties and perusing the material placed on record and taking into consideration the facts of the case, nature of allegations, gravity of offences, role attributed to the accused, without discussing the evidence in detail, at this stage, I am inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the applicant.

6. This Court has considered following aspects,
(i) though the FIR is in respect of supply of coconut to Dubai, the present applicant did not enter into any contact with the first informant.
(ii) As per the FIR, the present applicant is arraigned as accused no. 5, however, as per the FIR, the aforesaid coconut were to be exported to Dubai through accused no. 4 and 5 and accused no. 5 is the present applicant.
(iii) As per the report submitted by Police Inspector, Sarthana Police Station, though it was believed by him that the present applicant is a partner of Destiny Global Services in whose account the first informant had NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/11133/2023 ORDER DATED: 19/08/2023 undefined deposited around 13,00,000/-.

However, during the course of investigation, till date,
there is no documentary evidence has come forward indicating that the present applicant is partner of Destiny Global Services.
(iv) Upon a specific query by this Court that whether any of the owners of any neighboring offices have stated that the present applicant is the partner of Destiny Global Services or not.
Upon instructions, learned APP stated that event the owners of the neighboring offices also have not stated that the present applicant was partner of Destiny Global Services.

(v) there are no past antecedents reported against the present applicant;
(vi) the applicant is ready and willing to cooperate with the investigation.
7. In the facts and circumstances of the present case, since the custodial interrogation of the applicant is not required, I am inclined to consider the case of the applicant.
